scope: Isolated native credential/private-file tests, exact timer/worker cancellation and separate real native-store/OS integration, including private-runtime and read-only diagnostic paths with a synthetic verifier. Diagnostics inspect already-open stores only; they do not open factories, prove usable credentials, repair orphans or grant authority. Controlled close/reopen and injected post-rename acknowledgement loss are covered; notification and hardlink branches are reported explicitly. Not actual provider sign-in, production timer receiver/worker or app scheduling/recovery wiring, FeedMe UI/auth integration, process-hard-kill, physical-device, power-loss or iOS proof.
